module.description: Expo React Native client for mobile, browser web, and the desktop renderer UI.
ownership: composer, voice, settings, and desktop renderer UI

scripts.start: npm --prefix ../.. run build:client && concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,client,expo --prefix-colors yellow,blue,magenta "npm --prefix ../.. run watch:protocol" "npm --prefix ../.. run watch:client" "npm run start:expo"
scripts.eas-build-post-install: npm --prefix ../.. run build:app-deps && npm run build:terminal-webview
scripts.android:development: npm --prefix ../.. run build:client && cross-env APP_VARIANT=development expo prebuild --platform android --non-interactive && cross-env APP_VARIANT=development expo run:android --variant=debug
scripts.android:production: npm --prefix ../.. run build:client && cross-env APP_VARIANT=production expo prebuild --platform android --non-interactive && cross-env APP_VARIANT=production expo run:android --variant=release
scripts.ios:release: npm --prefix ../.. run build:client && expo run:ios --configuration Release
scripts.web: npm --prefix ../.. run build:client && concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,client,expo --prefix-colors yellow,blue,magenta "npm --prefix ../.. run watch:protocol" "npm --prefix ../.. run watch:client" "npm run web:expo"
scripts.test:e2e:desktop-chain: playwright test --project='Desktop Chrome' e2e/desktop-updates.spec.ts e2e/workspace-open-in-editor.spec.ts e2e/terminal-protocol-query.spec.ts
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix ../.. run build:app-deps && expo export --platform web
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name chisacode-app --branch main
